summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) for Concise Bounded Description in rdflib/graph.py (after all_nodes). It returns a new in-memory Graph containing triples with the resource as subject, recursively follows blank-node objects (cycle-safe via a seen set), and includes reified rdf:Statement triples whose rdf:subject is the resource. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with unit tests covering these cases, and a "Concise Bounded Description" section in docs/utilities.rst. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed. No CHANGELOG entry or black requirement was added.
